newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Owens-Illinois Q2 shr down with charges.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Owens-Illinois Q2 shr down with charges.

text.p: (Millions of dollars, except per share amounts)
Earnings per share of common stock:

(a) Write-off of unamortized deferred finance fees and redemption premiums related to indebtedness repaid or redeemed prior to its scheduled maturity totaled $136.9 million less applicable income taxes of $52.4 million.
(b) Increase in average shares outstanding from 1996 to 1997 resulted primarily from issuance of about 16.9 million shares in Q2 1997 in connection with a refinancing plan.

(a) Amount for 1997 includes: (1) a gain of $16.3 million ($16.3 million aftertax) on sale of remaining 49% interest in Kimble Glass, (2) charges of $14.1 million ($8.7 million aftertax) principally for guarantees of certain obligations of a business divested several years ago. These items recorded in Q1 1997.
Net aftertax effects of these items on 1997 earnings per share are as follows:
Charge for guarantee obligations and other 0.07
Gain on sale of Kimble Glass (0.13)

(b) Write-off of unamortized deferred finance fees and redemption premiums related to indebtedness repaid or redeemed prior to its scheduled maturity totaled $136.9 million less applicable income taxes of $52.4 million.

(c) EPS computed independently for each period presented. Due to issuance of 16.9 million shares of common stock in Q2 1997 and the resultant effect on average shares outstanding, per share amounts calculated on a year-to-date basis do not equal sums of such amounts calculated separately for each quarter.
(d) Increase in average shares outstanding from 1996 to 1997 resulted primarily from the issuance of about 16.9 million shares in 1997 for a refinancing plan.
